steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the scenario.
Allow the buyer to add vendors during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stage combination.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the event's required line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite the QA vendor available for the case.
Publish the configured eRFX event.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier session.
Open the Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor is shown the Required clause on the Technical stage.
Verify the vendor is shown the optional clause on the Technical stage.
Accept the Required clause in the vendor session; the optional clause is deliberately not selected.
Return to the buyer session before submitting the vendor bid through the supported bidding flow.
Submit the vendor's Technical response and RFQ quote at 100 using the supported two-stage vendor bid flow.
Verify that the vendor submission was accepted.
Inspect the vendor's RFQ-stage view.
Open the RFQ pricing stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the Technical-stage Required clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Verify the Technical-stage optional clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
